# Partas.Build

> An F# build-pipeline DSL whose stages declare the CLI options they read. Commands derive their
> System.CommandLine option set from the pipelines they activate, so options, validation and help text
> come from the pipeline definition instead of manual registration. Runs from a `.fsx` script or a build
> project.

## Start here

- [Capabilities](https://shayanhabibi.github.io/Partas.Build/build/capabilities/): every operation and Input combinator, one line each
- [Index](https://shayanhabibi.github.io/Partas.Build/build/): the layers, and a first pipeline
- [Composition](https://shayanhabibi.github.io/Partas.Build/build/composition/): nesting stages, and reusing commands across files
- [Hosting](https://shayanhabibi.github.io/Partas.Build/build/hosting/): running a build from a long-lived F# session (SageFs) through `Command.invoke`

## Ask the script rather than reading it

Every command generates its own `--help` from the stages it runs, and the flags listed there are exactly the
flags those stages bind. `<script> <command> --help` is the authority on what a command accepts.
`<script> <command> --explain` prints what the command would run, and runs nothing; add `--json` for the tree as
JSON. A run with `--json` ends in one line of JSON describing every stage and failure. Exit codes: `0` success,
`1` a stage failed, `2` usage error (nothing ran), `130` cancelled.

- [Agent instructions](https://shayanhabibi.github.io/Partas.Build/AGENTS-snippet.md): a block to paste into a
  consumer repository's `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` — `--help`, `--explain`, exit codes, and the JSON run result
